paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, divided into five bins.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 accuracy scores for the Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct model on the MATH-500 dataset, categorized into five bins. The horizontal axis represents the Pass@1 accuracy score, labeled "Pass@1", with categories at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0, and appearing to be evenly spaced. The vertical axis is labeled “Percentage” and presents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1.  There are five light blue bars, each representing a bin of Pass@1 accuracy. The bar corresponding to 0.0 has a height of approximately 0.011, representing 11.2% ; the bar corresponding to 0.2 has a height of approximately 0.034, representing 3.4%; the bar for 0.4 is roughly 0.034, representing 3.4%; the bar for 0.6 is approximately 0.058, representing 5.8%; and the bar for 1.0 reaches 0.762, representing 76.2%. A vertical dashed red line is positioned at 0.8 on the horizontal axis and labeled "mean: 0.82”. The bars are sorted in ascending order based on their Pass@1 accuracy category.
